sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
This wiki records a customised Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen campaign.

- Early play centred on [[vogler|Vogler]].
- A Halloween side adventure, the [[halloween-murder-mystery|murder mystery aboard the Bone Pelican]], introduced [[gears|Gears]].
- See the [[campaign-timeline|campaign timeline]] for the order of events and [[the-party|the party]] for the characters.
